headline: Man Convinced Cat Is Reincarnated Roommate; 'He Still Owes Me Rent'
subheadline: Viral post details eerily specific behavioral similarities between deceased friend and adopted feline
summary: A heartwarming yet legally complicated post about a man's belief that his cat is his late roommate has gone viral.
content:
A Threadit post titled "I think my cat is my old roommate reincarnated and he still owes me rent" has gone viral after the author presented a compelling—if legally unenforceable—case.

User u/CatOrKevin outlines the evidence: the cat, adopted six months after roommate Kevin's passing, exhibits behaviors identical to Kevin's. These include knocking items off surfaces "with the same specific wrist motion," sleeping in Kevin's exact preferred spot on the couch, and staring at u/CatOrKevin during dinner "like he's judging what I'm eating, just like Kevin did."

"Kevin always said ranch dressing was 'chaos in a bottle,'" the post explains. "Last week I ate a salad with ranch. The cat looked at me with such disappointment. That's Kevin. That's specifically Kevin."

The post has received over 30,000 upvotes and sparked debate about whether reincarnated roommates have legal financial obligations.

"If the cat is Kevin, then Kevin owes me for February 2023," u/CatOrKevin argues. "He said he'd pay me back 'soon.' It's been two years. Death doesn't discharge debts. Neither does becoming a cat."

Legal experts have weighed in with mixed opinions. "There's no precedent for collecting debts from alleged reincarnations," noted one attorney. "But I'm not saying it's impossible. Estate law is weird."

The post has a bittersweet undertone. Despite the jokes about rent, u/CatOrKevin clearly misses their friend. "Sometimes the cat does this thing where he puts his paw on my hand while I'm upset," they wrote. "Kevin used to do that. Minus the paw. But the energy is identical."

The cat has been named Kevin Jr. The debt remains outstanding at $847.

At press time, u/CatOrKevin had posted an update: "I showed Kevin Jr. a photo of Kevin. He meowed once. I don't know what that means but I'm taking it as acknowledgment of the debt."
author: Chris Patterson, Human Interest
